create_AVAMeter: create an AVAMeter to measure AVA train, val, and test stats for action detection
create_TestMeter: create a TestMeter to perform multi-view ensemble testing with clip aggregation across videos
create_TrainMeter: create a TrainMeter to measure training stats including loss, error rates, and learning rate
create_ValMeter: create a ValMeter to measure validation stats with top-1 and top-5 error tracking
create_ScalarMeter: create a ScalarMeter to track scalar values with a sliding window for median and average computation
